title: Chio theorem inventory (v1)
description: Schema for spec/registries/theorem-inventory.v1.json. Constrains the allowed status values to the canonical trajectory-4 closeout set (proposed, proven, assumed). Two transitional values (proven_partial, advisory_only) are grandfathered for legacy entries only and must be re-classified before the closeout gate flips. Any historical non-canonical status (such as the deprecated impl-backed label) is rejected by the spec/registries gate at scripts/check-trj4-no-implementation-backed.sh.

status.description: Theorem status. Canonical values are proposed, proven, assumed. The transitional values proven_partial and advisory_only are grandfathered for existing entries only; new theorems must use a canonical value. Non-canonical labels are rejected by the closeout gate.
